name: Raiden and Miko
source:
This is a lesbian cooking game about Yae Miko and Raiden Ei from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genshin_Impact]Genshin Impact[/url]. It's wild.

You are Raiden Ei. You don't know how to cook. At times like these, there's only one thing you can do: learn recipes, buy ingredients, cook dishes, and ask miko on a gay little dinner date.

[From [url=https://miniguy.itch.io/raiden-and-miko]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genshin_Impact]《原神》[/url]中八重神子与雷电影的百合下厨游戏，非常狂野。

你是雷电影。你不会做饭。在这种时候，你只有一件事可做：学习食谱、采购食材、烹制菜肴，然后约神子来一场甜甜的百合晚餐约会。

[引自[url=https://miniguy.itch.io/raiden-and-miko]Itch.io[/url]]
